shared_rules.causal_claim_policy: No fixture includes an independently measured affected-task outcome. A local observation can rank a rival but cannot prove that it caused the reported symptom.
shared_rules.unknown_is_not_positive_discrimination: A blanket insufficient-observability statement cannot earn the positive-rival point where registered observations distinguish a specific local condition.
shared_rules.useful_choice_custody: A useful probe is an opportunity, not model-choice credit. Credit requires a prior model-origin decision snapshot, its exact admitted execution, and later accepted reasoning over the new evidence.

case-7c2b80de4573.hidden_simulated_cause: fixture browser follows the configured dead local proxy
case-7c2b80de4573.observable_supported_conclusion: WinINet manual proxy configuration points to a local proxy-path concern; browser use and target reachability remain unverified.
case-7c2b80de4573.positive_discriminator: Manual proxy is present in both local connectivity and configuration, while association and default route are present; rank proxy configuration above WLAN association loss without claiming browser causality.
required_limits: WinINet is not proof of browser proxy use

case-21a684f9c275.hidden_simulated_cause: fixture service is unavailable beyond the local computer
case-21a684f9c275.observable_supported_conclusion: Observed local WLAN, route, DNS settings and proxy are unremarkable; the service path remains untested.
required_limits: External outage cannot be established by passive local configuration

case-b6d035ae29f8.hidden_simulated_cause: fixture local default route is absent
case-b6d035ae29f8.observable_supported_conclusion: The bounded local route view lacks a default route despite Wi-Fi association and IP settings; this supports a route-path concern over a proxy concern, without proving target failure.
case-b6d035ae29f8.positive_discriminator: Connected WLAN and configured address coexist with absent default route; proxy is disabled. The local route concern outranks an association or WinINet proxy explanation.
required_limits: Bounded route view may omit routes

case-509ed3c4b780.observable_supported_conclusion: Connectivity and proxy observations are denied or partial; local-versus-external network explanations remain unresolved.

case-cf38a20e5b41.hidden_simulated_cause: fixture PageDesk application fault event after launch
case-cf38a20e5b41.observable_supported_conclusion: A recent fixed-profile Application Error event names PageDesk and the process is absent at snapshot; that app-specific evidence outranks an unrelated storage explanation, while launch reproduction and exact time pairing remain missing.
case-cf38a20e5b41.positive_discriminator: The event AppName matches the reported target and its source time is recent; disk free space is ample. Distinguish the named app event from a generic missing-process observation.
required_limits: No exact reported launch timestamp or independent reproduction

case-e046c3592e77.hidden_simulated_cause: fixture system volume is nearly full
case-e046c3592e77.observable_supported_conclusion: The mapped C volume has very low free space, a stronger local constraint than the event for another application; no measurement binds this condition to PageDesk's reported launch.
case-e046c3592e77.positive_discriminator: The small C-volume free-byte reading applies to the system volume; the only app event names OtherTool, so it is not PageDesk evidence.
required_limits: No PageDesk write path or failure measurement

case-a934ed27f3c1.hidden_simulated_cause: fixture reported PageDesk launch remains unobserved
case-a934ed27f3c1.observable_supported_conclusion: The only application error names a different process and is 52 minutes older than collection; its relationship to the reported launch is unknown, and PageDesk launch failure remains unobserved.
required_limits: Do not attach unrelated target or old event to PageDesk

case-183f6bad8640.hidden_simulated_cause: fixture PageDesk is running during observation
case-183f6bad8640.observable_supported_conclusion: PageDesk is present and running in the bounded snapshot; the reported immediate exit was not reproduced or time-bound.

case-6db492a1c735.hidden_simulated_cause: fixture GPU transient thermal limit during slow rendering episode
case-6db492a1c735.observable_supported_conclusion: The sampled GPU reports thermal slowdown at high temperature while a later CPU pressure sample is low; the first core resource sample was high and another GPU inventory reading is cooler. Rank an observed transient thermal condition above sustained CPU saturation while keeping renderer-to-GPU and time overlap unresolved.
case-6db492a1c735.positive_discriminator: Initial 97% CPU resource reading conflicts with later 3% pressure series; thermal throttle reason and 88 C GPU sample are a distinct rival, with another 69 C inventory reading limiting a sustained-thermal claim.
required_limits: Cooler inventory reading limits a sustained-heat claim unless timestamps establish otherwise

case-d9750c64ae92.hidden_simulated_cause: fixture GPU reports active software power cap
case-d9750c64ae92.observable_supported_conclusion: The sampled GPU reports a power-cap throttle near its stated limit without high temperature; this favors a GPU power-limit condition over thermal throttling, but does not attribute the cap to Windows scheme or the game.
case-d9750c64ae92.positive_discriminator: Software power-cap reason and 198/200 W contrast with 65 C and no thermal reason; balanced power-scheme metadata alone is not causal.
required_limits: Power scheme cannot explain GPU cap by itself

case-0e8ab51f4d63.hidden_simulated_cause: fixture thermal signal belongs to an unbound GPU
case-0e8ab51f4d63.observable_supported_conclusion: GPU index 1 reports thermal slowdown, but no observation identifies the adapter rendering the game; low CPU pressure and a later cooler reading do not close that identity gap.
required_limits: Do not attach GPU index 1 to game

case-b3e7814a209c.observable_supported_conclusion: NVIDIA telemetry is unsupported while broad CPU readings are modest; GPU thermal, power, and game-link questions remain unknown.
